import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
ann=pd.read_csv('/workspace/GSE255742_annotations.tsv',sep='\\t')
meta_ct=ann.groupby('metacell')['cell_type'].agg(lambda s:s.value_counts().idxmax()).to_dict()
# number of cells per metacell
meta_n=ann.groupby('metacell').size().to_dict()
true=pd.read_csv('/workspace/GSE255742_metacell_expr.tsv',sep='\\t',index_col=0,low_memory=False)
true.columns=[int(c) for c in true.columns]
# true aggregate weighted mean by cells per metacell, for each subtype
# first map subtype -> columns
true_sub={}
for c in true.columns:
 ct=meta_ct[c]
 true_sub.setdefault(ct,[]).append(c)
# weighted average across metacells, using metacell normalized expression values
true_ct=pd.DataFrame(index=true.index)
for ct,cols in true_sub.items():
    # weighted mean = sum(expr[metacell]*ncell) / sum(ncell)
    weights=np.array([meta_n[c] for c in cols],float)
    true_ct[ct]=np.average(true[cols].values,axis=1,weights=weights)
print(true_ct.shape)
# merge subtypes matching input labels
merges={
'endoderm':['endoderm'],
'endostyle_csg':['endostyle_csg'],
'epidermal_neural':['epidermal_neural1','epidermal_neural2'],
'epidermis':['epidermis_1','epidermis_2'],
'mesodermal_notochord':['mesodermal_notochord'],
'muscular_somites':['muscular_somites'],
'neural':['neural'],
'neural_like':['neural_like1','neural_like2'],
'putative_neuro_endo':['putative_neuro_endo'],
'somite':['somite'],
'tailbud':['tailbud'],
'tailbud_neural':['tailbud_neural'],
}
# aggregate subtype means into merged cell type by weighted number of cells from annotations (not metacell columns)
cell_counts={ct:ann[ann.cell_type.isin(subs)].shape[0] for ct,subs in merges.items()}
# Better compute per metacell? already aggregated subtype; merge subtypes weighted by cell counts of subtypes
true_merge=pd.DataFrame(index=true_ct.index)
for ct,subs in merges.items():
    w=np.array([cell_counts.get(s,0) for s in subs],float)
    true_merge[ct]=(true_ct[subs].values @ w)/w.sum()
# Normalize each true column to sum 1e6
for c in true_merge.columns:
    true_merge[c]=true_merge[c]/true_merge[c].sum()*1e6
# load input
hdr=None; ids=[]; vals=[]
with gzip.open('/workspace/inputs/sample.swap.rna.q1.tsv.gz','rt') as f:

    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); ids.append(p[0]); vals.append(list(map(float,p[1:])))
M=pd.DataFrame(vals,index=ids,columns=hdr)
common=[g for g in true_merge.index if g in M.index]
A=true_merge.loc[common].values
B=M.loc[common].values
print('\\nPearson log1p normalized true vs input')
for j,inp in enumerate(hdr):
    scores=[]
    for k,tr in enumerate(true_merge.columns):
        r,_=pearsonr(np.log1p(B[:,j]),np.log1p(A[:,k]))
        scores.append((r,tr))
    scores.sort(reverse=True)
    print(inp,'->',' '.join(f'{tr}:{r:.3f}' for r,tr in scores[:3]))
print('\\nSpearman')
for j,inp in enumerate(hdr):
    scores=[]

        r,_=spearmanr(B[:,j],A[:,k])
        scores.append((r,tr))
    scores.sort(reverse=True)
    print(inp,'->',' '.join(f'{tr}:{r:.3f}' for r,tr in scores[:3]))

 delta,i,j,di,dj,cij,cji=p
 print(f'{order[i]},{order[j]} delta={delta:.6f} self={di:.6f},{dj:.6f} cross={cij:.6f},{cji:.6f}')
